policy: Unchanged original MR40 signals, momentum30 episode admission, original exits, all-cash long/flat; no cap40 and no new parameter.

cohorts.role: new candidate-specific historical follow-up beyond prior September endpoint; warm previous history, fresh account
continuous historical follow-up; no monthly account or admission resets

data_rules.required_days: Every complete UTC day October 1 through 19; do not use unfinished UTC day October20.
data_rules.source: Official Bybit Spot BTCUSDT raw trade daily gzip archive only; reuse hash-verified local sources and audited aggregations, fetch missing days from the official HTTPS source.
data_rules.format: Accept six-column header, or documented five-name header with exactly six trade fields including RPI; record schema. No skipped rows or imputed candles.
data_rules.validation: SHA256 and gzip EOF/CRC; monotonic trade ID and timestamp, exact UTC day, finite positive price, finite nonnegative quantity, side/RPI enum, six observed 4h buckets per day.
data_rules.fail_closed: If complete coverage or provenance cannot be established, record the exact missing date/source and do not score a silently shortened substitute.
data_rules.warmup: Append to the immutable 8400-bar previous input; preserve every prior row, verify contiguous 4h cadence and original input digest.
data_rules.freeze: Record exact source receipts and augmented-input digest before any new performance score.

classification.reason: October raw days were previously used by other NEXUS studies, including Elliott. They were not scored for this frozen MR40 candidate before this stage; this is historical follow-up, not unseen project data.
